explanation.headline: Esomeprazole sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 16.4 days on hand for the 20 mg/5 mL presentation and Corvale General has 25.5 days on hand for the same presentation

sentences.text: FDA's records show esomeprazole sodium is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 132 vials of the 20 mg/5 mL presentation with 8.1 vials used per day, providing 16.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 242 vials of the 20 mg/5 mL presentation with 9.5 vials used per day, providing 25.5 days on hand.
For the 40 mg/5 mL presentation, Corvale East has 311 vials at 9.5 per day (32.7 days) and Corvale General has 308 vials at 9.8 per day (31.5 days).
The rule-based best option is to buy from Eugia US LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Two registered plants appear on current labels: Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) with a VAI inspection ending 2024-07-25, and Hainan Poly Pharm. Co., Ltd. (FEI 3005115952) with a VAI inspection ending 2023-06-30.
Check whether the Eugia US LLC product can be traced to a registered plant with an acceptable inspection history before committing to purchase.
